name: Primary hosting outage
description: Loss of the primary hosting environment interrupts essential business applications.
consequence: Critical services may be unavailable until infrastructure is restored.

name: Malware disrupts business systems
description: Malware infection could encrypt or disable systems used to deliver business services.
threat: Malicious email attachment or compromised endpoint
vulnerability: Some endpoints may miss security updates
consequence: Service interruption, recovery cost, and potential data exposure.

name: Backup restoration failure
description: Backups may be incomplete or unusable when systems need to be restored.
threat: Backup job failure or corrupted backup media
vulnerability: Restore tests are not performed consistently
consequence: Recovery may exceed the agreed recovery time and cause data loss.

name: Privileged account compromise
description: An attacker may gain control of an administrator account and access production systems.
vulnerability: Privileged access review may be delayed
consequence: Unauthorized changes, data exposure, or prolonged outage.

name: Critical application change causes outage
description: An untested software or configuration change could make a production application unavailable.
vulnerability: Rollback steps may not be sufficiently rehearsed
consequence: Users may lose access to essential applications during recovery.

name: Payment processing interruption
description: An interruption to payment processing could delay customer or supplier transactions.
consequence: Delayed payments, reconciliation backlog, and customer complaints.

name: Fraudulent payment instruction
description: A fraudulent or altered payment instruction may be processed before detection.
vulnerability: Payment details may not receive independent verification
consequence: Financial loss, investigation effort, and regulatory reporting obligations.

name: Payment reconciliation backlog
description: Transaction records may not reconcile promptly after a system or data feed interruption.
vulnerability: Exception queues may not be reviewed promptly
consequence: Inaccurate reporting and delayed identification of missing transactions.

name: Finance system access unavailable
description: Finance staff may be unable to access payment and accounting systems during a disruption.
vulnerability: Contingency access procedures may be incomplete
consequence: Payment and month-end activities may be delayed.

name: Key payment provider disruption
description: A critical payment provider outage could prevent normal transaction processing.
vulnerability: Alternative provider arrangements may not be ready
consequence: Transactions may be delayed until provider service is restored.

name: Employee records unavailable
description: HR staff may be unable to access employee records needed for essential people services.
vulnerability: Offline recovery information may be out of date
consequence: Payroll and employee support requests may be delayed.

name: Sensitive employee data disclosure
description: Sensitive employee information may be accessed or shared with unauthorized parties.
threat: Phishing, misdirected email, or unauthorized access
vulnerability: Access rights may not be reviewed regularly
consequence: Privacy impact, employee harm, and possible regulatory notification.

name: Payroll processing delay
description: A disruption to payroll inputs or processing may delay employee payments.
threat: Late data, system outage, or missed processing deadline
vulnerability: Limited time for payroll recovery before payment date
consequence: Employees may be paid late and additional manual work may be required.

name: Loss of key HR process knowledge
description: Absence of staff with specialist HR process knowledge could slow essential services.
vulnerability: Process documentation and cross-training may be limited
consequence: Employee requests and time-sensitive HR tasks may be delayed.

name: HR records retention or deletion error
description: Records may be retained longer than required or deleted before their retention period ends.
threat: Incorrect retention configuration or manual handling error
vulnerability: Retention schedules may not be consistently applied
consequence: Audit findings, privacy concerns, or inability to evidence decisions.
